{{Quote|I really wish these two would just be quiet for a while. I need to think. On one hand, I do really want to get off of this forsaken rock. But on the other hand, I don't really like the idea of being beholden to Jabba the Hutt or to Lady Valarian.|Prost Roberts|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''Prost Roberts''' was an untrained [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I could join the military. To be honest, I don't really like the way the Empire seems to treat their pilots. They seem too much like fodder to me. I'm leaning towards the Rebel Alliance. I'm hoping I can fly with them until I'm able to support myself.|Prost Roberts|<ref name="SWG" />}}
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Prost Roberts could be found outside the [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. While there, he encountered a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]], and started complaining about the two pilots arguing next to him, [[Anim Kahn]] and [[Rel Keteris]]. Even though he wanted to leave Tatooine, he was not keen of the idea of working for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] or [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]].

He considered the possibility of joining the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], but admitted he did not like the way the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] treated its [[TIE pilot|pilots]]. He revealed that he was leaning towards joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] until he became able to support himself.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Prost Roberts is a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. In the game, he simply tells players that he would rather fly as a pilot for the Rebel Alliance, rather than the Empire, Jabba, or Lady Valarian.
